title: Dissipative Cosmology and the Nature of Dark Energy: Insights from Bulk Viscosity with DESI DR2 observations
efc_relevance: Bulk-viscous DE mimicking DESI DR2 dynamical-DE preference under Planck + SN combined; same thermodynamic-dissipation family as EFC's entropic-flow ansatz and as arXiv:2606.04886 and arXiv:2605.28797. The bulk-viscosity coefficient ζ(ρ) is the direct functional analogue of EFC's K(ρ) and must be mapped explicitly.
ledger_action: Add to WP1 as dissipative-DE mechanism comparator; cross-reference framework:Quintom-Feng2005, arXiv:2606.04886, arXiv:2605.28797 and arXiv:2503.14738; required ζ(ρ) ↔ K(ρ) mapping in recovery-conditions table.
